verses.text: YHWH reigns, let the earth rejoice, let the many shores be glad!

segments.text: YHWH reigns, let the earth rejoice, let the many shores be glad!

verses.text: Cloud and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of His throne.

segments.text: Cloud and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of His throne.

verses.text: A fire goes out before His face, and burns up His adversaries round about.

segments.text: A fire goes out before His face, and burns up His adversaries round about.

verses.text: His lightnings give light [to] the world; the earth sees, and trembles.

segments.text: His lightnings give light [to] the world; the earth sees, and trembles.

verses.text: The mountains are melted like wax from before the face of YHWH, from before the face of the Lord of all the earth.

segments.text: The mountains are melted like wax from before the face of YHWH, from before the face of the Lord of all the earth.

verses.text: The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the peoples see His glory.

segments.text: The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the peoples see His glory.

verses.text: Let all those serving a carved image be put to shame, those boasting in idols! Bow down to Him, all gods!

segments.text: Let all those serving a carved image be put to shame, those boasting in idols! Bow down to Him, all gods!

verses.text: Zion hears and is glad; the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of Your judgments, O YHWH.

segments.text: Zion hears and is glad; the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of Your judgments, O YHWH.

verses.text: For You, O YHWH-Elyon, [are] over all the earth; greatly are You exalted over all gods.

segments.text: For You, O YHWH-Elyon, [are] over all the earth; greatly are You exalted over all gods.

verses.text: O lovers of YHWH, hate evil; He preserves the souls of His holy ones; from the hand of the wicked He delivers them.

segments.text: O lovers of YHWH, hate evil; He preserves the souls of His holy ones; from the hand of the wicked He delivers them.

verses.text: Light shines on the righteous, and gladness for the upright of heart.

segments.text: Light shines on the righteous, and gladness for the upright of heart.

verses.text: Be glad, O righteous ones, in YHWH, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness!

segments.text: Be glad, O righteous ones, in YHWH, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness!
